entries.name: Single pod
entries.composition: Exactly ONE closed pod, upright, centred, the same 3/4 front view as the owner's current pod icon. No ribbon, bow, chest, bag or extra pod.
entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready Roblox Shop/developer-product icon, ONE 512x512-design square PNG, genuinely transparent background.
Match the owner's Luckhollow Mysterious Pod from the supplied model reference. It is NOT an egg-shaped capsule: keep its squat HEX-FACETED DARK BARK shell standing on SIX chunky root toes, moss-green pointed leaf plates on the flat sides with thin glowing lime vertical veins, straight gold corner vines/posts capped with small faceted gold buds, gold rim around the closed leaf-green lid, inward-leaning angular leaf-petal crown, and a small flat FOUR-leaf clover on a thin central stem on top. Front plate has the exact diamond-shaped GOLD FRAME with green four-leaf clover inlay and little gold hub from the reference, not a money logo or a generic round coin. Keep the closed lid and actual brown/forest-green/lime/gold palette. The reference image's geometry is the identity; do not invent a different pod, mouth, eyes, creature, hatch contents, wings or horns.
Rendering style: match the supplied Shop icon family. Glossy chunky cartoon/toy object with soft plastic shading, controlled bright upper-left highlight, warm gold trim, crisp big readable shapes and a thick PALE cream-white STICKER outline around the WHOLE outer silhouette. Internal separations are subtle, not heavy black outlines. Preserve the pod's blocky/faceted leaf construction; no photorealism or flat vector treatment. Readable at64px. No label is part of the object.
Framing: centered, object/group fills about80% of the square's longest dimension with modest balanced empty padding and no clipped root toes, crowns, sparkles or lid. A restrained soft MINT glow and at most a few small mint/white sparkles may sit close to the object, within the same padded silhouette. True alpha transparency everywhere else; no solid background, plate, studded badge, checkerboard, frame, floor, cast-shadow platform, collage or mockup.
Absolutely NO text, letters, digits, quantity numbers, x1/x3/x10/x50 labels, prices, Robux symbol, rarity cue, watermark or brand logo. Never reveal a creature or anything inside a pod. A bundle chest may be open, but ALL PODS themselves remain CLOSED. Each output is exactly one icon, not an atlas or a set.
Reference roles: image1 is the actual pod identity and 3/4 pose. Image2 shows the model from several directions; use ONLY the CLOSED front/3/4/back views, NEVER the open view, and never copy its captions. Images3 and4 show ONLY Shop-family sticker shading, outline and finish; do not copy their egg, shoes or colours.
Composition: Exactly ONE closed pod, upright, centred, the same 3/4 front view as the owner's current pod icon. No ribbon, bow, chest, bag or extra pod.

entries.name: Three pods
entries.composition: Exactly THREE identical closed Luckhollow pods grouped compactly: one larger front pod in 3/4 view, TWO slightly smaller pods behind on left and right with their green leaf crowns, gold trim and bark forms readable. Their roots/crowns overlap naturally as a bundle. No ribbon, bow, chest or extra fourth pod.

entries.name: Overflowing chest

entries.name: Gift single
entries.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: one glossy Roblox Shop product gift icon, transparent square PNG.
Make the GIFT twin of the pod icon in image1. Image1 is the EDIT TARGET and contains exactly ONE CLOSED Luckhollow Mysterious Pod. Keep the same exact pod geometry/identity, 3/4 pose, dark bark root toes, green leaf plates/crown/clover, gold vines/buds/rim and front gold diamond clover panel. Keep its closed state and pale sticker outline. Do not replace it with a generic present box, egg or another pod; no creature or contents.
Image2 is ONLY the approved gift ribbon/bow colour and material reference: glossy scarlet-red ribbon, deep red folds/shadows, fine warm GOLD edge piping, large twin-loop bow with two pointed tails. Add the SAME ribbon cross-wrap around the one pod, a large red/gold-edged bow at the top and ONE small blank cream gift tag attached near the bow. The tag has NO text or number. Ribbon should partly cross/encircle the object while leaving its leaf crown and front medallion recognisable; do not hide the entire pod inside a box. Keep exactly ONE pod. It must instantly read as a gift at64px.
Match the Shop family's chunky glossy soft-plastic shading and upper-left highlights. Thick pale cream-white sticker outline around the entire silhouette. Minimal soft mint glow close to the pod, no new ornaments.
Composition: zoom out enough that the WHOLE pod, root toes, gift bow, tag and sticker outline fit comfortably INSIDE the square with about10% empty padding on every side, object longest dimension about80% of canvas. Nothing touching or clipped by any canvas edge. Genuine transparent alpha background everywhere else, no opaque plate/black box/checkerboard/floor. 512x512-design square PNG, one icon only.
NO text, prices, Robux marks, brands, quantities, watermarks, rarity cues, numbers, extra pod or creature. Only the ribbon, bow and blank tag are added to the source object, with proportional overall rescaling if needed to fit.

entries.name: Gift three
entries.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: one matching glossy Shop gift-product icon, transparent square PNG.
Image1 is the bundle EDIT TARGET. Image2 is our already-created gift-single icon, ONLY for the EXACT red ribbon/bow/blank-tag design, colour palette, gold edge piping and scale relationship; do NOT add image2's single pod as a new object. Image3 is the original Shop gift-material reference, NOT a present box to insert.
Preserve exactly THREE visible closed pods: one front and two behind, as in image1. Do not add or remove a pod.
Add ONLY gift wrapping to the target: Bind the THREE-pod group together as ONE present with a scarlet-red, gold-edged cross-wrap ribbon, one large matching twin-loop bow above the group and one blank cream tag. Keep all three pod crowns visible so the gift is still a recognizable three-pod bundle.
Use the SAME glossy scarlet-red ribbon with deep red folds and fine gold piping, wide looped bow with two pointed tails, and one small plain cream paper tag as image2. Tag stays completely blank, no letters, quantities, prices or marks. The ribbon should show a cross-wrap, not merely a loose bow. It must read as a present at64px while still revealing the real pods.
Keep the same closed bark-shell, green faceted leaf plates/crowns, lime veins, gold posts/buds and front diamond clover medallion. Preserve the Shop family's chunky soft-plastic shading, upper-left highlights, pale cream-white sticker outline, restrained mint glow and existing few sparkles. No creature or outcome shown, ever. Do not redesign the pods or convert them to eggs.
Framing: zoom out enough that the ENTIRE gift bundle, crowns, any root toes, chest lid, bow, tag and sticker edge fit inside a square with about10% empty padding each side; object about80% longest canvas dimension. No clipped edges. 512x512-design PNG with genuine alpha background; no solid plate/background, frame, checkerboard, floor, shadow platform or collage.
NO text, digits, x3/x10/x50 quantity marks, Robux symbols, money, cash, shoes, rarity hints, logos or watermarks. One icon only.
